name: Awei C11T Small Adapter with Type-C Cable
description:
6 Months Official Warranty
Awei C11T 1m Type-C Data Sync Cable Single Output USB Charger Fast Charging Small Power Adapter COD
1. ABS material+technological transparency
2. Synchronous rectification scheme, wide voltage
3. Main control IC Xingjingtai 3611
4. Equipped with overvoltage and overcurrent protection function
5. Suitable for Type-C phone charging
6. Input: 100- 240V AC 50/60Hz 0.5A
7. Output: 5V/2.4
